title: Multi-Compare Button / Scenario Selection Entry Point
type: ui/navigation only (no new backend, no new financial logic)
primary_user_story: As a user, I can open the Scenario workspace, select 2-4 saved Generic scenarios, and click 'Compare selected scenarios' to open the multi-compare table.
scope: Generic exploratory path first. UI/navigation only.

new_template.notes: Picker UI (heading + banner + checkbox list + Compare button + counter) + inline vanilla JS (no Alpine, no Tailwind, no jQuery, no HTMX for picker logic). <noscript> fallback <button type="submit"> for no-JS users.

workspace_wire.notes: Conditional include of the new partial, gated on {% if is_user_project and not (multi_compare_result or multi_compare_error) %}. Picker is hidden when the multi-compare table is already shown (no duplication). Hidden for factory projects (TUHO / Oborovo).

css.notes: New .scm-pick-* classes (additive; :root count = 3 preserved). All colors via CSS variables (var(--sidebar-*, var(--text-*, var(--accent-*, etc.). No Tailwind @apply, no Alpine x-data.

javascript.notes: Vanilla JS, no dependencies. Listens to checkbox change events, enforces 2-4 cap (un-checks the 5th), updates Compare button href + aria-disabled. Isolated to the picker root (queries [data-testid='multi-compare-picker']). No global state mutation.

empty_and_partial_states.0_scenarios: Empty state: 'No saved scenarios. Save at least 2 scenarios to enable multi-compare.' No form.
empty_and_partial_states.1_scenario: Partial state: 'Only 1 saved scenario. Save at least 1 more scenario to enable multi-compare.' + locked, checked, disabled checkbox for the existing scenario. No form.
empty_and_partial_states.2_to_4_scenarios: Happy path: form + checkboxes + counter + Compare button. Counter starts at '0 of 2-4 selected'. Compare button starts aria-disabled.
empty_and_partial_states.5_plus_selections: JS un-checks the (5th) checkbox. User cannot submit with >4.
empty_and_partial_states.no_run_output: Picker renders the row (IRR meta is hidden if no last_run_summary); Compare button still works. Multi-compare table handles missing values (from 25B-2 endpoint).
empty_and_partial_states.missing_scenario_id: Cannot happen via picker (all checkboxes are server-rendered). Direct URL hit returns 'could not be resolved' error message (from 25B-2 endpoint).

exploratory_safety.generic_solar_or_generic_wind: Shows EXPLORATORY banner with safety copy 'Generic project. Multi-compare is exploratory / not Excel-parity validated.'
exploratory_safety.non_generic_user_projects: Shows descriptive banner 'Multi-compare is descriptive only. The first scenario you pick is the Base reference for deltas.'
exploratory_safety.no_reference_or_validated_claim: The picker NEVER shows 'Reference' or 'Validated' badges — only the EXPLORATORY warning for generic projects.

blocks.name: Empty and partial states
covers: 1 scenario partial state with locked checkbox

blocks.name: End-to-end integration
covers: form GET submission works without JS

unchanged_but_referenced: main_web.py (/scenarios/compare-multi route unchanged; picker just navigates to it)

before_25b2_1: Open DevTools or right-click 'Inspect' on the saved scenarios.
Copy the data-scenario-id attribute from each scenario row.
Paste it into the address bar.
after_25b2_1: Below the existing 'Saved Versions' list, a new 'Multi-Compare' section appears with checkboxes.
Check 2-4 scenarios. The '0 of 2-4 selected' counter updates. The Compare button enables.
Click 'Compare selected scenarios'. The browser navigates to the multi-compare URL and the table renders.
If the project is generic_solar or generic_wind, the EXPLORATORY warning is visible at the top.

what_is_NOT_in_this_phase: No 'Move to top' / re-order for Base scenario (follow-up)
No keyboard shortcuts beyond standard browser tab navigation
No scenario search / filter for 50+ scenarios (follow-up)
No bulk delete / archive from the picker
No link from the multi-compare table back to the picker ('Edit selection') (follow-up)
No live preview of the multi-compare table as the user toggles checkboxes (follow-up)
recommended_next_phase: 25B-2.2 ('Edit selection' link from multi-compare table back to picker) or 25B-3 ('What changed' delta indicator).
